title: Berlin Central Bus Station - Quick Summary
items: **Most long-distance buses arrive at the ZOB**, the central bus station at Messedamm 8 in Westend, next to the Funkturm radio tower. It is about 7 km west of Alexanderplatz, so plan one more ride after you step off.

**Two stations cover the onward trip.** S Messe Nord/ZOB, about 300 m from the platforms, carries the Ring S-Bahn (S41/S42). U Kaiserdamm, a similar walk up Messedamm, carries the U-Bahn toward Zoologischer Garten, Potsdamer Platz and Alexanderplatz.
**A single AB ticket costs 4.00 EUR** and covers the whole ride into the city, including changes. A 24-hour AB ticket is **11.20 EUR** and usually pays off on your arrival day.

**FlixBus also serves eight other Berlin stops**, including Alexanderplatz, Hauptbahnhof, Suedkreuz, Ostbahnhof and Zoologischer Garten. If your ride offers one near your hotel, choose it when you book and skip the ZOB entirely.

**At night the U-Bahn stops running on weeknights.** From roughly 1:00 the N2 night bus at Kaiserdamm covers the route to Alexanderplatz; on Friday and Saturday nights the U-Bahn runs all night. Fares and times checked on 30 August 2026.
